title: Reviewed semantic refinements for generated VP wire contracts
$comment: Source overlay: intersected with schemars-derived DTO shapes. Never replace a generated shape or weaken Rust runtime validation. Additional constraints include bounds, public-ID patterns and required explicit nullable output fields.

SecretRef.description: Vault lookup only; never inline secret material.

TlsTrust.description: Server authentication trust policy. spki_sha256 pins hash the DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo, NOT the full certificate. Certificate-fingerprint URI fields cannot be mapped to this variant.

clientHelloFingerprint.description: TLS ClientHello/browser profile name (for example chrome), NEVER a certificate digest or SPKI pin. Compiler must preserve or reject unsupported choices.

requirements.description: Hints only. Compiler MUST derive and validate exact capabilities from model fields; caller cannot bypass capability gating by omitting requirements.

PreviewProtocol.description: Secret-reference-free import preview protocol. Hysteria2 obfuscationRef must be null; hasObfuscation is a separate boolean.
